notes.title: Version 1.06 Released
notes.content:
We sincerely apologize for the long wait. "Let's Take a Bath with Purin 2" now supports VR!

The game is compatible with **HTC VIVE** and **Meta Quest 3**.  
We would appreciate any reports of functionality on other devices.  
When playing in VR, please ensure a space of at least 2 meters in front and 3 meters to the sides.  
Make sure you have enough room to fully extend your arms. Due to the nature of the gameplay, you'll often want to move forward, so make sure there's plenty of space in front of you.

For those using Meta Quest with **SteamVR**, please turn off SteamVR before starting the game, as running both can cause significant performance issues.

We've also added **tips** within the game.  
They are displayed during loading screens, though they may be difficult to see depending on your environment.

Additionally, we've made some small adjustments.  
It's now a bit easier to land punches.  
We've also added more options to the settings menu.

notes.title: Version 1.03 Release
notes.content:
New hairstyles have been added.
You can purchase hairstyles with points from the second page of the shop. Purchased hairstyles are separated by parts and can be selected from the hairstyle menu on the title screen.
We have implemented a window switching function on the second page of the options.
Please refer to the manual for details.
